F3_sibling_boundary_audit.source_scope: Completed 16-world 60-day tuning cohort only. No held-out reads or metric calculations.
F3_sibling_boundary_audit.method: Group all inventories by both known ordered parent ids; combinations once per world; independently mark pairs that share a non-null settlement in any hourly snapshot. Also count any joint alive snapshot regardless of settlement.
F3_sibling_boundary_audit.classification: Concrete literal-contract population mismatch. Temporal sampling is underspecified for nine never-co-observed pairs, but 31 concurrently alive different-settlement pairs establish a restriction independent of that ambiguity.
F3_sibling_boundary_audit.recommendation: Preserve original registration and result. A separately source-bound literal analysis should use all recorded full siblings, without co-residence or lifetime-overlap restrictions, versus all unrelated same-settlement pairs.
